I used to think attention was a muscle. Now I'm not so sure. A muscle gets stronger when you strain it; my attention just gets brittle. What actually helps is safety. When I feel held, I can stay with a hard paragraph, a hard conversation, a hard morning. When I don't, I scatter. So maybe the question isn't how to focus harder. Maybe it's how to make focus feel safe — for me, and for the people I'm trying to love well.
